mechanism_narrative: A higher current level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity and economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO exceeds its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 4.0%, it signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 4.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising housing starts (HOUST) and declining retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a shift from durable to non-durable consumer spending, signaling economic weakness and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST > 12mo_avg and RSAFS < 12mo_avg, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), a higher current level of the federal funds rate compresses equity valuations through increased discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher current level of retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS exceeds its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 105.0 (index 2017=100), it signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate earnings growth and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 105.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1200.0 (thousands of units), it signals a strong housing market that boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST > 1200.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A lower current level of real GDP (GDPC1) indicates economic contraction that reduces corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 is below its 4-quarter moving average, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
